<!-- pr-reviewer: 79b256d8b43565dc2dd3edfed28e23c21af8100c -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good
- The group "Set WCS from features" moves to the WCS page, above "Work offset (G54-G59)" (`pages.rs`). The Setup page keeps four groups (`GROUPS` has four titles).
- No function is lost. The same `wcs_pick_row::row` is drawn, so Pick, role box, picked list and Apply are unchanged. Apply queues the same undoable `SetWcs`. No command is new, so no MCP tool is owed. The UI writes no WCS field directly.
- The pick gate follows the drawn row. The test shows that a draft stays armed on the WCS page and pauses when the page is left.
- Structural assertions are updated. No snapshot PNG changed. No new icon. The UI text is plain English. The layers are unchanged (ui -> app).
- The row wraps (`horizontal_wrapped`), so the button stays in the narrow pane.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` outside tests. The decision entry `docs/decisions/1926-wcs-picks-on-wcs-page.md` exists. The body has a `Changelog:` line, `Fixes #1926` and before/after images. The merge with `origin/main` is clean.

## Results merged with main (local, not the runner)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib wcs` (from `crates/ui`) | 47 passed, 1 ignored |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (full) | 1004 passed, 6 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

App tests were not run: no app file changed.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Notes (not blocking)
1. The `press_pick` helper (last commit) is a harness matter, not a product defect. egui decides a click from the widget rects of the previous frame. A test that moves the pointer and presses in the same frame, right after a layout change, can miss the button. A real user moves the pointer over many frames before a click. Evidence: the test itself shows that the row arms and stays armed once pressed. No product code changed, and the same button is clicked directly in older tests. A short comment on the helper is enough.
2. `pages.rs` (658 lines) was already over the 400-line limit and grows by 5 lines. This is not blocking. A later split along the page seam is welcome.
3. Not exercised by the author, and not here: a real viewport click on the WCS page (covered by the existing `wcs_pick_click_tests`).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
